patient_persona.description: Mr. Yeoh Kian Meng, 36, male, sales manager in Setapak, Kuala Lumpur; cold two weeks ago that got better then worse again. Fast, confident KL Mandarin heavily mixed with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Anis Syafiqah Mohd Yusri, Malay woman in her 30s, GP at a Setapak clinic who speaks fluent Mandarin from Chinese school. Crisp, friendly; Mandarin and English mixed.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor，我两个礼拜前 flu，本来已经好了，这三天又突然变严重，脸这边很痛，especially 低头的时候。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 痛的是这边 cheek 吗？还是额头？有没有发烧？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 右边 cheek，还有牙齿上面也痛。昨晚有发烧，38.5。鼻涕是 greenish 的，有时候有 bad smell。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 本来好转了又 worse again，我们叫 double worsening。加上发烧和单边脸痛，这个比较像 bacterial sinusitis。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那终于可以吃 antibiotic 了吧？上次的 doctor 都不给我。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 上次是 viral，吃 antibiotic 没用。这次有 indication，我开 amoxicillin-clavulanate 625mg，一天两次，吃七天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一定要吃完七天吗？我通常好了就停。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 一定要吃完，不然细菌没有 clear 完，可能会 relapse，也会造成 resistance。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 另外 mometasone nasal spray，每边两下，一天两次，帮助 sinus 的 drainage。还有 saline rinse，早晚洗鼻子。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 洗鼻子那个我试过，水流到喉咙，很 geli 的感觉。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 刚开始会不习惯，头要向前低一点，嘴巴张开呼吸。用 sachet 泡温开水，不要用 tap water。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay，我 try。我下个礼拜要 fly 去 Bangkok 出差，可以吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，但是起飞和降落的时候耳朵会痛，可以先喷 spray，嚼口香糖。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 明白。有什么要特别注意的吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果眼睛周围肿、视力模糊、或者头痛得很厉害、脖子硬，马上去 emergency，这个是 complication。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，noted。谢谢 doctor。

patient_persona.description: Puan Norhayati binti Jaafar, 40, female, insurance agent in Batu Pahat, Johor; five days of blocked nose and facial pressure, wants antibiotics before a work trip. Assertive, fast Johor Malay with lots of English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chua Boon Keat, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, GP at a Batu Pahat clinic. Patient, explains clearly; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, hidung saya tersumbat dah lima hari, muka rasa berat, especially bila tunduk. Boleh bagi antibiotic tak? Saya ada outstation Isnin ni.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya faham, puan. Let me check dulu. Ada demam tak? Sakit gigi or sakit sebelah muka je?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Demam sikit hari pertama. Sakit dua-dua belah pipi, dengan dahi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Suhu hari ni 36.9, normal. Muka ada tender sikit. Ini more likely viral sinusitis, lepas selsema.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Viral? Tapi hingus saya hijau, doktor. Isn't that a sign of bacteria?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a common myth. Warna hijau datang dari sel badan yang lawan virus, bukan semestinya bacteria.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Antibiotic biasanya considered kalau lebih ten days tak baik, high fever dengan nanah, or makin teruk after getting better.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So saya just tunggu je lah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bukan tunggu je. Saya bagi fluticasone nasal spray, dua spray each side, sekali sehari. Saline rinse pagi dan malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For pain, paracetamol 1 gram, sehari empat kali maximum. Pseudoephedrine boleh ambil tiga hari untuk hidung tersumbat, kalau takde darah tinggi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Takde darah tinggi. Okay lah. Tapi kalau masa outstation jadi teruk?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If lepas sepuluh hari masih tak okay, or demam tinggi balik, jumpa klinik terdekat. Or you can do teleconsult with us.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik lah, doktor. I ingat nak dapat antibiotic, hehe.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I tahu. Tapi ubat yang tak perlu, kesan sampingan je yang dapat, cirit-birit semua.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, faham. Thank you, doktor.

condition: Recurrent acute sinusitis in a diabetic

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Shanti a/p Velu, 55, female, tuition centre owner in Ipoh, Perak; type 2 diabetes; third sinus infection this year, follow-up after a course of antibiotics. Articulate, a little anxious, Malaysian Indian English with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chandran a/l Muthusamy, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, family medicine specialist at an Ipoh health clinic. Thoughtful, unhurried; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mrs. Shanti, you habiskan the antibiotics last week. How's the sakit muka now?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Better, doctor, the sakit muka dah hilang. But this is my third time tahun ni, I'm quite fed up already.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Three episodes setahun, that's worth looking into properly. Gula macam mana lately?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Not so good lah. The HbA1c last month was 9.2. Tuition season, I makan anyhow, late night.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Gula tinggi makes infections more common and lambat sembuh. That's one piece of the puzzle.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Do you have hidung tersumbat or kurang bau between the episodes, or totally clear?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Actually my smell is not so good for months. Masak kari pun tak dapat bau properly.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That suggests there may be ongoing inflammation or polyps. I'll refer you to ENT at Hospital Raja Permaisuri Bainun for a scope.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Scope? Must put camera in my nose ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, a thin one, with numbing spray, tak sakit. Lima minit je. They may do a CT scan of the sinuses too.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Meanwhile what should I do?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Keep using mometasone spray every day, even bila sihat. Saline rinse once a day. And let's work on your kencing manis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll increase metformin to 1 gram twice a day, and ask the dietitian to see you. Sugar better, sinus pun better.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright, I'll try to control my makan. My students' exams finish next month.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Jumpa lagi in six weeks, bawa your sugar diary.

condition: Acute sinusitis in a breastfeeding mother

patient_persona.description: Puan Julia Anak Sagau, 28, female, Kadazan kindergarten teacher in Keningau, Sabah, breastfeeding her four-month-old; twelve days of sinus symptoms. Soft, polite Sabah Malay with some English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Mei Chin, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Keningau health clinic. Kind, reassuring; Malay mixed with English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Julia, dah dua belas hari hidung tersumbat, betul?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Betul, doktor. Mula-mula selsema biasa, tapi tak baik-baik. Now gigi atas sebelah kiri pun sakit bah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada demam? Hingus warna apa, ada bau busuk?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Demam sikit-sikit petang. Hingus kuning, kadang-kadang ada bad smell.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lebih sepuluh hari tak baik, dengan sakit gigi atas, it's likely bacterial sinusitis. Kita boleh bagi antibiotic.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tapi saya masih menyusukan baby. Ubat tu masuk susu ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sikit je masuk susu, and amoxicillin is safe for breastfed babies. Ramai ibu guna, no problem.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Amoxicillin 500mg, tiga kali sehari, tujuh hari. Paracetamol 1 gram bila sakit, also safe for breastfeeding.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau baby cirit-birit macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kadang-kadang baby jadi najis lembik sikit, that's normal. Tapi kalau ada rash or dia tak nak menyusu, bawa jumpa kami.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, doktor. Spray hidung boleh guna juga?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, saline spray dan mometasone spray safe semasa menyusu. Minum air banyak, rehat bila baby tidur.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susah nak rehat, doktor. Baby bangun tiap dua jam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I know, penat sangat. Minta suami tolong jaga malam for a few days, supaya puan cepat recover.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Haha, nanti saya bagitahu dia doktor yang suruh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, cakap saya yang suruh. Kalau muka bengkak or mata merah bengkak, datang terus.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Soo Kim Hock, 66, male, retired fishmonger in Kuantan, Pahang; sinus symptoms for a week, woke up with a swollen left eye. Worried, Kuantan Mandarin with Hokkien and Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Syazwan Mat Isa, Malay man in his 30s, GP at a Kuantan clinic who speaks some Mandarin. Calm but firm; Mandarin with English and Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我鼻塞一个礼拜了，今天早上起来左边眼睛肿起来，红红的，我老婆叫我快点来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我看一下。眼睛动的时候痛吗？看东西有没有 double，就是两个影子？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 动的时候有一点痛。看东西……好像有一点模糊。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有没有发烧？头痛厉害吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 昨晚发烧，今天吃了 Panadol。头很痛，从来没有这样痛过。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Soo 伯，你的眼睛周围肿，眼球动的时候痛，视力也模糊，这个可能是 sinus infection 扩散到眼睛。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 啊，那很严重吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个是 emergency，要马上去 Hospital Tengku Ampuan Afzan。可能需要打 IV antibiotic，还要照 CT scan。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可以吃药就好吗？医院要等很久。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不行，吃药不够。如果拖太久，可能会影响视力，甚至扩散到脑。我现在写 referral letter，打电话给他们。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，好，我听你的。我自己可以开车去吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你一只眼睛看不清楚，不要开车。叫你老婆或者孩子载你，或者我们帮你叫 ambulance。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我儿子在外面等，他可以载我。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好。这封信给 emergency 的 doctor 看。你有没有 diabetes 或者其他病？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有糖尿病，吃 metformin。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我会写在信里面。现在就去，不要回家拿东西，叫家人后面再送。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 明白，谢谢医生，terima kasih。

patient_persona.description: Encik Zulkarnain bin Mohamad, 42, male, fisheries officer in Kuala Terengganu, bringing his son Adam, 10, with fever and sore throat for two days. Calm, Terengganu Malay with a few English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Siew Ling, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Kuala Terengganu health clinic. Friendly, clear; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, Adam demam dua hari, tekak sakit sangat, tak lalu makan. Nasi pun tak nak telan, just minum susu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dia batuk tak? Hidung berair?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Takdok batuk, hidung pun okay. Cuma demam dengan tekak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Suhu 38.9. Tonsil dia besar, merah, ada nanah putih. Kelenjar kat leher bengkak dan sakit. Tak ada batuk, so ini lebih kepada bacterial tonsillitis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena antibiotik lah ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya. Adam 32kg, saya bagi penicillin V 500mg, twice a day, sepuluh hari, full course.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sepuluh hari? Lamanya. Kalau lepas three days dah okay?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kena habiskan juga sepuluh hari. Strep bacteria ni kalau tak clear, boleh bagi masalah jantung atau buah pinggang later on.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, tak tahu pula macam tu. Makan before atau after food?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Penicillin V lebih baik perut kosong, sejam sebelum makan. Paracetamol 500mg bila demam, setiap enam jam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dia boleh pergi sekolah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rehat dulu. Lepas 24 jam makan antibiotik dan demam turun, baru boleh pergi school.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makan apa yang sesuai? Dia tak lalu langsung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagi makanan lembut, bubur, air sejuk, aiskrim pun boleh. Paling penting dia minum cukup.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiskrim boleh? Adam, dengar tu. Terima kasih, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau dia tak boleh telan air liur, suara jadi pelik, atau susah buka mulut, datang terus. That's an emergency.

patient_persona.description: Ms. Chew Xin Yi, 19, female, accounting student at a university in Kampar, Perak; fifth tonsillitis this year, missing classes. Soft-spoken, polite, Perak Mandarin with English study words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Jason Loh Wai Kit, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, GP at a Kampar clinic. Gentle, explanatory; Mandarin mixed with English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我又喉咙痛了，这是今年第五次了。每次都要请假，我的 assignment 都来不及交。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这次什么时候开始的？有发烧吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 前天开始，昨天发烧 38.7。吞口水都很痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 tonsils 又肿又有白色的 exudate。颈部淋巴也肿。我们做一个 rapid strep test。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 结果是 positive。所以这次是 strep，要吃 penicillin。你对 penicillin 有没有 allergy？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有，以前吃过都没事。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Penicillin V 500mg，一天两次，吃十天。Paracetamol 1g，痛的时候吃，一天最多四次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我妈叫我问，是不是可以把 tonsil 割掉？每次都这样好辛苦。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个叫 tonsillectomy。一般 guideline 是一年 seven times，或者连续两年每年五次，或者三年每年三次，才 consider。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我今年五次，去年好像四次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那你接近了。我建议你每次发作都记下来，日期、发烧几度、有没有看医生、有没有 MC。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我可以用手机 note 记。那如果真的要割，要去哪里？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我会 refer 你去 Hospital Raja Permaisuri Bainun 的 ENT clinic 看。手术之后大概要休息两个礼拜。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 两个礼拜，那最好是 semester break 做。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，可以跟 ENT 讨论时间。这次先吃药，我给你 MC 两天，好好休息。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢医生。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Kishen a/l Rajan, 24, male, barista at a mall café in Klang; four days of sore throat, now can hardly open his mouth. Muffled 'hot potato' voice, Malaysian Indian English with Malay slang.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nur Amirah Zainol, Malay woman in her 30s, emergency medical officer at Hospital Tengku Ampuan Rahimah, Klang. Efficient, reassuring; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, four days my throat sakit, but today very teruk. Cannot open mouth properly, cannot even swallow my saliva.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I can hear your voice sounds muffled, macam ada benda dalam mulut. Which side is more painful?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Right side, doctor. The pain go up to my ear also. Last night fever, menggigil.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me have a look with the torch. Buka mulut as much as you can. I can see bengkak above your right tonsil, pushing the uvula to the left.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is that bad? I thought just tonsil only.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This looks like a peritonsillar abscess, also called quinsy. Ada nanah terkumpul next to the tonsil.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pus? Aiyo. So what, need to cut ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The ENT team will likely drain it, guna jarum or a small cut, under local anaesthetic. It gives very fast relief.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sakit tak, doctor? I'm scared of needles.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: They'll bius it first. Most people say the relief after is worth it. We'll also start IV antibiotics and a drip, since you tak boleh minum.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Need to stay in hospital?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Probably one or two malam. Once you can swallow and demam turun, you can go home with oral antibiotics.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Can I call my manager? Esok I'm supposed to open the café, shift pagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sure, and I'll bagi MC. I'm calling ENT now. Kalau rasa susah bernafas while waiting, beritahu nurse immediately.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Thank you, doctor.

patient_persona.description: Cik Farhana binti Abdul Latif, 30, female, bank clerk in Seremban, Negeri Sembilan; sore throat and fever, allergic to penicillin. Clear, articulate Negeri Sembilan Malay with English office words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Vincent Kok Chee Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, GP at a Seremban clinic. Careful, friendly; Malay mixed with English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cik Farhana, sakit tekak sejak bila?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sejak semalam, doktor. Demam 38 lebih, tekak macam kena pisau bila telan. Painkiller pun tak jalan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada batuk, hidung berair?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Takde batuk. Just tekak dengan demam, and badan lenguh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tonsil you merah dan bengkak, ada exudate putih. Kelenjar leher pun tender. Ini kemungkinan strep tonsillitis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya alergi penicillin. Last time makan amoxicillin, satu badan naik ruam and bibir bengkak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Bibir bengkak tu serious reaction, so we avoid penicillin and amoxicillin completely.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi erythromycin 500mg, sehari dua kali, sepuluh hari. Makan lepas makan, sebab dia boleh buat perut tak selesa.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Perut memang sensitif sikit, gastric. Kalau loya macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Makan dengan makanan, and minum air. Kalau muntah sampai tak boleh telan ubat, datang balik, kita tukar ubat lain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Boleh tak doktor tulis dalam rekod pasal allergy ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dah, saya dah letak allergy alert dalam sistem. You also should wear an allergy card or bracelet.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bagus idea tu. MC boleh bagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dua hari MC. For pain, paracetamol 1 gram, and kumur air garam suam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor.

condition: Viral versus streptococcal tonsillitis in a child

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Wong Siew Ping, 35, female, Foochow hairdresser in Miri, Sarawak, bringing her daughter Kai Xin, 6, with fever and sore throat. Expressive, Sarawak Mandarin mixed with Malay and English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Rosnani binti Jamil, Malay woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Miri health clinic who speaks conversational Mandarin. Warm, practical; mixes Malay, English and simple Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我女儿昨天开始发烧，喉咙痛，还有咳嗽流鼻涕，眼睛也红红的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 她几岁？六岁对吗？有没有 ruam，或者肚子痛？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对，六岁。没有 ruam，但是昨晚说肚子有一点痛，吃了一点 bubur 而已。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tonsil dia merah, tapi takde nanah. Ada batuk, hidung berair, mata merah. 这个比较像 viral，不是细菌。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 所以不用吃 antibiotic 吗？她的班上有同学是 strep throat。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好问题。为了确定，我们做一个 rapid strep test，swab 喉咙，十分钟就有结果。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，做吧。Kai Xin，乖，一下下而已。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Result negative. Jadi ini viral tonsillitis, antibiotic 没有用。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那她要吃什么？她不肯吃药，一吃就吐。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol syrup 250mg per 5ml, bagi 7ml setiap enam jam kalau demam. 可以加一点 juice 一起喝。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 她 20 公斤，7ml 可以吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, betul. Bagi dia minum air sejuk, aiskrim, bubur. Tekak sakit 大概三到五天会好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 她可以去 tadika 吗？我要上班。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 退烧之后才去，大概两三天。不然会传染给其他小朋友。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，那我请我妈妈帮忙看。If 还是很烧呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau demam lebih tiga hari, tak nak minum langsung, or susah bernafas, bawa balik jumpa saya.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay，terima kasih doktor，谢谢。
